review_PRESET_DESCRIPTIONS: review the PRESET_DESCRIPTIONS dictionary mapping ParlAI opt preset aliases to human-readable descriptions
summarize_PRESET_DESCRIPTIONS: summarize the available ParlAI opt preset descriptions for models like Meena, BlenderBot, BART, and SeeKeR
list_preset_aliases: list all opt preset alias keys from the PRESET_DESCRIPTIONS dictionary in docs.py
lookup_preset_description: lookup the human-readable description for a specific ParlAI opt preset alias like gen/meena
reference_preset_papers: reference the arxiv paper links associated with each ParlAI opt preset in PRESET_DESCRIPTIONS
